declared_generalizations.note: Bell Tower position used as a stable central-Xi'an orientation point, not as the start of every journey.
All dashed connectors indicate direction from central Xi'an only. They are not railway lines, roads, measured travel times, or live navigation routes.
Generalized Wei River orientation for regional context; not survey geometry or a navigation feature.
Generalized Qinling mountain band used only to explain why southern and eastern choices behave as mountain days.
Marker is a declared midpoint for the Lintong archaeology day, not a station, entrance, or live route waypoint.
South Peak is used as the regional mountain marker; the line does not represent the train, road, cableway, or walking route.
Museum complex centre from the pinned OpenStreetMap way; pickup arrangements remain a live check.
Named peak is an orientation marker; visitors must remain on the scenic area's currently open managed route.
Main Qianling attraction point; current access to associated tombs and indoor spaces requires a same-day official check.
